Director Id Application Guide

A step by step guide to applying for your Director Identification Number, who needs one, what you need and how to complete the application.

Trusted on Google

Book your appointment

Speak with a registered tax agent about your situation.

  • Registered tax agents

  • Servicing clients Australia wide
Book Appointment 1300 043 325
Setup Guide

How to Apply | Step-by-Step

Follow these steps to apply for your Director ID. Open any step to see exactly what to do.

Step 1 — Set Up Your myID

Before applying, you must create your digital identity.

What is myID? myID is your secure digital identity used to access government services. (It is different from your myGov account.)

  • What you need:
  • A smartphone
  • A personal email address (not shared or work email)
  • Two identification documents, such as: Driver’s licence Passport Medicare card Birth certificate
  • Driver’s licence
  • Passport
  • Medicare card
  • Birth certificate
  • Download the myID app from the App Store or Google Play
  • Open the app and enter your personal details
  • Verify your email
  • Add your identity documents
  • Select “Standard” indentity strenght
Step 2 — Prepare Your Information

Before starting your application, ensure your details match what the ATO has on file.

You will need:

You must also confirm your identity using 2 of the following:

  • Your Tax File Number (TFN)
  • Your residential address (as per ATO records)
  • Bank account details linked to ATO
  • ATO Notice of Assessment
  • Superannuation account details
  • PAYG summary / income statement
  • Centrelink payment summary
Step 3 — Apply for Your Director ID

Follow these steps:

Authentication:

Complete your application:

Outcome:

• Your Director ID is usually issued instantly on screen

  • Go to the official ABRS application page
  • Click “Apply for Director ID – ABRS ”
  • Log in using your myID
  • You will receive a notification on your phone
  • Open the myID app
  • Enter or accept the code
  • Enter your: • TFN • Residential address • Identity verification details
  • Review all information carefully
  • Submit your application
Step 4 — Save & Provide Your Director ID

Once issued:

• Download or save your Director ID • Keep it secure • Provide it to Ideal Business Group Team so we can proceed with your setup

Apply by Phone If you cannot apply online: Call: 13 62 50

Apply by Paper If you: • Do not have a TFN • Cannot verify your identity online

Documents must be certified (e.g. JP, solicitor)

You can find more information on the official ABRS website: Apply for your director ID | Australian Business Registry Services (ABRS)

Penalties for Non-Compliance

Failure to obtain a Director ID may result in serious consequences, including:

It is important to apply as soon as possible to avoid these risks

Apply promptly

Ensure your details match ATO records

Keep your Director ID securely stored

Provide your Director ID to your accountant

  • Criminal penalties of up to approximately $13,200
  • Civil penalties of up to approximately $1,000,000
  • Possible disqualification from managing a company
  • Infringement notices issued by regulatory authorities

Director ID Application Guide

What is a Director ID? A Director ID is a unique identification number that all company directors are required to obtain under Australian law. Once issued, it stays with you permanently, even if you:

  • Change companies
  • Stop being a director
  • Change your name or move overseas

Why is this required? The Director ID system was introduced to improve transparency and prevent illegal activities such as “phoenixing” ,where companies are closed to avoid debts and restarted under a new structure. By assigning a unique ID to each director, regulators can better track director activity and protect the integrity of the system.

Legal Requirement All directors under the Corporations Act must have a Director ID. If you have not applied yet, it is important to do so as soon as possible to remain compliant and avoid penalties.

Video Guide If you prefer a visual walkthrough, you can watch the official step-by-step guide below. Watch video instructions Alternatively, follow the detailed instructions below to complete your application at your own pace.

Frequently Asked Questions

Need quick answers? Ask us directly.

Everything you need to know about working with Ideal Business Group. Still have a question? Our team is one call away.

Call Us Now
Do I need to apply myself?
Yes, you must complete the application yourself. For security reasons, no one (including your accountant) can apply on your behalf.
How long does it take?
If applying online, most applications are completed within 5–10 minutes, with the Director ID issued immediately.
What if I am not tech-savvy?
You can follow the step-by-step guide or the video provided. If needed, you may also apply by phone (13 62 50) or paper. You can find more information on the official ABRS website: Apply for your director ID | Australian Business Registry Services (ABRS)
Do I need to apply again?
No, your Director ID is permanent and stays with you for life.
What happens if I don’t apply for a Director ID?
If you do not obtain a Director ID when required, you may be considered non-compliant under Australian law. This can lead to penalties issued by regulatory authorities.
Are there financial penalties for not having a Director ID?
Yes, penalties may apply. This can include: • Criminal penalties of up to approximately $13,200 • Civil penalties of up to approximately $1,100,000
What if I forget my Director ID?
You can:
What if my details don’t match ATO records?
Your application may fail or be delayed. Ensure your details are updated before applying.
Can I apply without a TFN?
Yes, but you may need to apply using the paper method with certified documents. You can find more information on the official ABRS website: Apply for your director ID | Australian Business Registry Services (ABRS)
What should I do after receiving my Director ID?
Please provide your Director ID to the Ideal Business Group team so we can update our records.

Frequently Asked Questions

Need quick answers? Ask us directly.

Everything you need to know about working with Ideal Business Group. Still have a question? Our team is one call away.

Call Us Now
Do I need to apply myself?
Yes, you must complete the application yourself. For security reasons, no one (including your accountant) can apply on your behalf.
How long does it take?
If applying online, most applications are completed within 5–10 minutes, with the Director ID issued immediately.
What if I am not tech-savvy?
You can follow the step-by-step guide or the video provided. If needed, you may also apply by phone (13 62 50) or paper. You can find more information on the official ABRS website: Apply for your director ID | Australian Business Registry Services (ABRS)
Do I need to apply again?
No, your Director ID is permanent and stays with you for life.
What happens if I don’t apply for a Director ID?
If you do not obtain a Director ID when required, you may be considered non-compliant under Australian law. This can lead to penalties issued by regulatory authorities.
Are there financial penalties for not having a Director ID?
Yes, penalties may apply. This can include: • Criminal penalties of up to approximately $13,200 • Civil penalties of up to approximately $1,100,000
What if I forget my Director ID?
You can:
What if my details don’t match ATO records?
Your application may fail or be delayed. Ensure your details are updated before applying.
Can I apply without a TFN?
Yes, but you may need to apply using the paper method with certified documents. You can find more information on the official ABRS website: Apply for your director ID | Australian Business Registry Services (ABRS)
What should I do after receiving my Director ID?
Please provide your Director ID to the Ideal Business Group team so we can update our records.
